verdict.summary: The round-1 findings are resolved. Recovery 1 now correctly distinguishes the pre-merge resume path from post-merge activation and no longer suggests that an unmerged PR can activate. Recovery 2 now states that the editable account record is only a transcript/comparison input, not authorization or provenance, and routes widening through live grant-label equality plus a checked row-scoped account-pool branch. Its manual fallback likewise requires the exact provenance-carrying branch and confines that PR to the policy grant. The guidance accurately describes the fail-closed membership and provenance checks, including the already-available activation no-op occurring only after all proofs run. No blocker, major, or other actionable issue remains in this documentation-only diff.
